description: The line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity across 64 relation categories for five different experimental conditions, with the x-axis representing the relation category (ranging from 0 to 63) and the y-axis showing the mean interclass similarity (ranging from 0.0 to 0.5). The plot includes five lines: "w/o DPO obo" (solid blue line), "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (solid orange line), "DPO" (solid green line), "Average of w/o DPO obo" (dashed light blue line), and "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (dashed orange line). The "w/o DPO obo" line starts at approximately 0.22, peaks sharply near category 0 at 0.48, and then fluctuates with a general downward trend, ending near 0.02. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" line begins at 0.10, peaks at 0.45 near category 31, and ends at 0.07. The "DPO" line starts at 0.19, peaks at 0.18 near category 23, and ends at 0.07. The dashed lines represent the average values of their respective solid lines, with the "Average of w/o DPO obo" line remaining relatively flat around 0.107, and the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" line staying around 0.158. The plot also includes text annotations for the average values of the "DPO" and "w/o DPO obo" lines, which are 0.086 and 0.107, respectively.
